articles.title: U.S. Jobless Claims Unexpectedly Edge Down To 197,000
articles.expand: A day ahead of the release of its more closely watched monthly jobs report, the Labor Department released a report on Thursday showing first-time claims for U.S. unemployment benefits unexpectedly edged slightly lower in the week ended September 26th. The Labor Department said initial jobless claims slipped to 197,000, a decrease of 1,000 from the previous week's revised level of 198,000.

articles.title: Economic and event calendar in Asia Thursday, October 1, 2026 - we hear from the Bank of Japan
articles.expand: It's a packed data agenda for the session here. I'll be mostly awaiting the Bank of Japan 'Summary'. The Bank of Japan's Summary of Opinions is a short document that collects the views expressed at a monetary policy meeting, published without naming who said what. It gives the market a read on the tone of the debate behind the decision, which the announcement itself doesn't show. Traders use it to judge how close the board is to another move.
